title: S2: restoreFromBackup can crash into a permanently stranded store

description: It moves the live store file out from under an OPEN coordinator, and reconfigure(to: prev) no-ops when prev == currentMode - a crash landing at .preparing leaves the app writing to an unlinked inode (MigrationCoordinator.swift:170-189, PersistenceHost.swift:124). Failure scenario: restored data is invisible, the journal is cleared, and the user is told recovery succeeded. Severity: Critical. Wave/Plan: Wave 2, plan 2b backup-restore-correctness. Sweep: sync machinery. Verified directly against source.
